title: Recipe 70 — Making a CrewHaus agent consumable (MCP server + agent-to-agent)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Every other recipe consumes tools. This one turns your agent into somebody else's tool.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — serving the agent means real model calls per request.

beats.label: Type the recipe's support agent
beats.cue: “Ten lines. Nothing here knows it's about to become an MCP server.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Clean. Projection is a serve-time decision, not a spec-time one.”

beats.label: Compile it and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN, gated at the model credential.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Read the serve contract
beats.cue: “--mcp projects the cli agent as an MCP server — stdio by default, or HTTP+SSE with --sse.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “One `chat` tool, exposed over a standard protocol. Claude Code or an IDE can pick it up as-is.”

beats.label: Type the expose block
beats.cue: “And the declarative form: what this agent advertises about itself to anything that asks.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “GET /.well-known/agent-card — the a2a discovery document, generated from this.”

groups.title: Beat 3 · the other side — an orchestrator that consumes it

beats.label: Blank the scratch spec
beats.cue: “Now flip it around: an agent whose tools are other agents.”

beats.label: Type the orchestrator
beats.cue: “The remote agent is declared exactly like any other tool. That uniformity is the whole a2a story.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Clean — permissions and gates apply to a remote agent the same as a local tool.”

beats.label: Compile it and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN, gated at the credentials the spec declares for the remote.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the declared credentials gate

beats.label: Show the federation env gate
beats.cue: “Any unset ⇒ the federation routes answer 404. Fail-closed, so a half-configured mesh can't silently half-work.”
beats.command: env -u CREWHAUS_FEDERATION_DEPLOYMENT_ID crewhaus lint live/crewhaus.yaml > live/fed.txt 2>&1

verify.note: lint is unaffected — the federation identity is a runtime gate, not a spec one

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “The gate is at boot, not at compile. That's why recipe 27's discover beat fails closed.”

beats.label: Serve over stdio
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Point Claude Code at this and your agent shows up as a tool in its catalog.”

verify.note: long-lived stdio MCP server; needs a model credential

beats.label: Serve over HTTP+SSE
beats.cue: [needs-key] “--sse for anything that can't spawn a subprocess — a browser, a remote orchestrator.”

verify.note: long-lived HTTP server; needs a model credential

beats.label: Read the agent-card section
beats.cue: “Discovery, capability advertisement, and the federation routes — the whole consumable surface.”
